primary_plan.name: NIFTY Iron Condor (monthly expiry, OI-wall-centered)
primary_plan.structure: SELL 24200 PE + BUY 24100 PE (100-wide put spread) + SELL 24500 CE + BUY 24600 CE (100-wide call spread). Net width 100 on each side. Defined risk on both wings.
primary_plan.rationale_data_driven: OI walls 24,200 PE / 24,500 CE are where dealers are short. Selling AT these walls captures the fattest premium while the walls hold on monthly expiry. Max pain 24,300 (between the walls) is the magnet. NIFTY currently 24,208 = just above 24,200 wall = good entry. The 100-wide wings keep max loss manageable (~Rs.4,500 = 4.2% of capital).

entry_signal.trigger: After 09:30 IST opening range is established
conditions_all_required: Spot is inside 24,000-24,500 (between or at OI walls)
US futures (or SGX NIFTY proxy) overnight move < 0.4%
skip_if: Gap up > 0.5% (directional risk too high for condor)
Major US news overnight (NVDA miss, PCE hot)

primary_plan.entry_timing_logic: Don't enter first 30 min (gap noise). After 09:45 OR is established, wait 15 more min for confirmation. If OR high/low is being respected, enter.

expected_premiums_rupees.total_credit_lot2_NOT_USED: N/A — 1 lot only for monthly expiry

max_loss_rupees.both_wings_combined: Rs.9,000 - 11,250 (if BOTH wings breached — unlikely on monthly expiry)

exit_rules.profit_target: Combined credit collected > 60% (i.e., 50% of max profit) → close early
exit_rules.stop_loss: Either wing delta > 0.50 (prob ITM breach) OR combined mark-to-market loss > 60% of max loss → close that wing
exit_rules.time_stop: HARD CLOSE by 14:30 IST. Do NOT hold into last 30 min on monthly expiry (whipsaw gamma risk)
exit_rules.force_square: FIX #3 hard-kill at 15:15 if anything still open

adjustments.if_nifty_drops_to_24150_by_11am: BUY back 24200 PE to lock in remaining call-side credit (NIFTY showing weakness, protect the put side)
adjustments.if_nifty_rises_to_24400_by_11am: BUY back 24500 CE to lock in remaining put-side credit (NIFTY showing strength, protect the call side)
adjustments.if_breakeven_at_1330: Hold to 14:00, then close at 14:00 to free up capital

alt_1_bearish_breakdown.name: Bearish breakout (if 24,000 breaks)
alt_1_bearish_breakdown.trigger: NIFTY breaks 24,000 with volume > 1.5x 5d-avg by 11:00 IST, AND close below 24,000 on 15-min candle
alt_1_bearish_breakdown.rationale: FII short 1.84L contracts + bear trend + monthly expiry OI breakdown. Risk-defined long put, not naked short.
alt_1_bearish_breakdown.target: NIFTY 23,800 by 13:30 — close at 2x premium paid
alt_1_bearish_breakdown.stop: NIFTY reclaims 24,100 on 30-min candle — close at 50% premium
alt_1_bearish_breakdown.validity: Only if breakdown is confirmed. Do NOT preempt — let price prove it.

alt_2_bullish_mean_reversion.name: Bullish MR bounce (if 24,000 holds and bounces)
alt_2_bullish_mean_reversion.trigger: NIFTY opens weak, dips to 24,000-24,050 in first 30 min, then bounces back above 24,150 by 10:30 with volume
alt_2_bullish_mean_reversion.rationale: Oversold RSI 29 + OI support 24,200 + DII heavy buying + max pain 24,300 above = mean reversion target.
alt_2_bullish_mean_reversion.validity: Only if bounce is confirmed with volume.

alt_3_no_trade.name: NO TRADE (if conditions don't support any plan)
alt_3_no_trade.trigger: ANY of: gap > 0.7%, first 30-min range > 250 pts, US futures moved > 0.5% overnight, no clean OR, VIX > 13
alt_3_no_trade.rationale: Capital preservation > forced trading. Monthly expiry whipsaw + bad data = NO TRADE is the right answer.
alt_3_no_trade.action: BOT SHOULD NOT TRADE TODAY. Bot reads mavis_trades.json and finds action=BLOCK or alt_3 active. Skips both NIFTY and BANKNIFTY for the day.

banknifty_decision.reason: BANKNIFTY 57,784 vs max pain 57,500 = 284 pts ABOVE max pain. Magnetic drift would be DOWN, but 50-day EMA support at 57,235 is strong. The range is too wide (57,235-57,900+) for a tight condor to be safe, and BANKNIFTY is choppier on monthly expiry than NIFTY. Liquidity is also thinner at our strike widths. SKIP BANKNIFTY today.

intraday_decision_tree.phase_1_pre_market_08_25: Read thesis cron. Check overnight US close (already in research). Check Asia open (SGX NIFTY) at 08:00. Refresh mavis_trades.json if anything materially changed.
intraday_decision_tree.phase_2_opening_09_15_to_09_45: OBSERVE ONLY. Log: opening gap (vs prev close 24,207.75), first 30-min high/low, volume vs 5d avg. Do NOT place orders.
intraday_decision_tree.phase_3_decision_09_45: Apply primary entry_signal.conditions_all_required. If all met: WRITE 'ENTER' in mavis_trades.json. If not: check alternatives. If alternatives don't trigger either: WRITE 'CANCEL' (NO TRADE).
intraday_decision_tree.phase_4_early_management_10_00_to_11_30: If ENTERED: monitor delta of both wings. If either delta > 0.30, consider adjustment. Trail stop on directional plays.
intraday_decision_tree.phase_5_midday_11_30_to_13_30: Manage. Reduce position if realized vol spikes. No new entries (mid-day noise).
intraday_decision_tree.phase_6_afternoon_13_30_to_14_00: Hold winners. If combined credit collected > 60%, close to lock profit.
intraday_decision_tree.phase_7_force_square_14_00_to_14_30: HARD CLOSE all positions by 14:30. Monthly expiry whipsaw in last 30 min is NOT worth the gamma risk. Even if at max profit, take the money.
intraday_decision_tree.phase_8_hard_kill_safety_15_15: If anything still open (bot crash, missed force-square), FIX #3 hard-kill at 15:15 forces emergency close. Theta burns remaining time value — accept whatever close price.

risk_management.max_daily_loss: Rs.7,500 (7.5% — stop trading for the day if hit)
risk_management.position_sizing: 1 lot NIFTY (75 shares equivalent). NO 2-lot on monthly expiry.
risk_management.premium_buffer: Assume you'll get 30% less than mid. If mid=50, expect 30-35.

what_makes_this_different_from_template.template_behavior: Bot runs iron_condor on NIFTY AND BANKNIFTY every day at 09:30 IST, regardless of market. Same strikes (ATM ±2, ATM ±4), same conf 0.60-0.65. From 22 trading days of journal data, 21 were template iron_condors.
mavis_behavior: 1. Read ACTUAL data: max pain, OI walls, FII/DII flows, US markets, trend, RSI, VIX
2. Make a specific decision: this is RANGE BOUND with UPWARD GRAVITY, trade NIFTY condor centered on OI walls
3. SKIP BANKNIFTY: too wide, too choppy, monthly expiry liquidity poor at our widths
4. Define EXACT entry signals: only enter if gap < 0.5%, OR < 200 pts wide, no panic
5. Define EXIT signals: time-stop 14:30, delta-stop 0.50, profit-take 60%
6. NO TRADE if conditions don't support any plan — capital preservation
